confirmed_by: values typed from the printed drawings (the person-confirmed project profile of the generic route); M3 adds two printed foundation values transcribed from the drawing set (the PDF general notes have no text layer, so they are typed here, not read by the engine)

conventions.title: Typical ground-beam sections by span (ST7757 p.13 titles)
conventions.source: ST7757.pdf p.13 typical ground-beam titles '< 2.5 m (30x30)', '< 5 m (30x40)', '> 5 m (30x60)' (vector glyphs; typed)
conventions.rationale: Read as exclusive span bands; exterior beams 'FOLLOW ARCH.' are not separated by the generic route (a known limit).

conventions.title: Founding level below plot level (footing underside)
conventions.source: ST7757 general note (PDF, transcribed): excavation not less than 1.50 m below plot level
conventions.rationale: The printed minimum is the base and the low end; 2.00 m is a planning upper bound, not printed (RFI).

conventions.title: Top of the foundation necks (GF level above plot level)
conventions.source: GF level +1.00 printed on the architectural section P7757 VE-AA-09 (the lift stops GF +1.00, 1F +5.50)
conventions.rationale: The neck runs from its footing top to the GF level, where the GF column starts (its height is GF +1.00 to 1F +5.50 = 4.50).

conventions.title: Ground-floor level above plot level
conventions.source: GF level +1.00 printed on the architectural section P7757 VE-AA-09 and on the ground-beam plan (+1.00)
conventions.rationale: The top of the exterior ground-beam detail is the ground-floor slab level.

conventions.title: Outer ground level beside the building
conventions.source: levels printed outside the building on the ground-beam plan (SH08): +-0.00 and +0.15
conventions.rationale: The exterior detail runs down to the outer normal ground level; the plan prints +-0.00 and +0.15 outside the building, which set the range.

conventions.title: Printed exterior ground-beam detail
conventions.source: ST7757 PDF p.13 'Ground Beams. for exterior walls' (labels 'Ground Floor slab level' and 'Outer Normal ground level'); bars from the detail-evidence document
conventions.rationale: The exterior detail spans from the ground-floor slab level to the outer ground level; width as the typical sections (30 cm).

conventions.title: Blinding (plain concrete) thickness
conventions.source: ST7757 PDF p.13: '10cm Plain con.' in both typical footing details (OCR notes P13N01, P13N02 - each under a footing caption, read again visually) and a 10 cm hatched layer dimensioned under every typical ground-beam section; not reviewed by a person
conventions.rationale: The isolated-footing details print 10 cm plain concrete under 5 cm screed and a membrane; the ground-beam sections draw the same 10 cm layer. The screed and membrane are separate works, not blinding.

conventions.title: Members that sit on blinding
conventions.source: ST7757 PDF p.13: the plain-concrete layer is drawn and dimensioned (10 thick, 10 projection each side) under all four typical ground-beam sections and under both typical footing details
conventions.rationale: Both typical details show the layer.

conventions.title: Continuous beam support (MID) bars: fraction of the span on each side
conventions.source: ST7757 DXF continuous-beam typical details on SH03, SH05 and SH07 (layer S-DIM.SCH): dimension texts '0.22 Ln', '0.22 Ln1', '0.22 Ln2' measured from the support face
conventions.rationale: Printed on all three typicals. The '0.3 Ln2' and '0.15L' dimensions bind to no support bar and are not used.

conventions.title: The span 'Ln' of the support-bar dimension
conventions.source: ST7757 DXF CB typical details: 'Ln' / 'Ln1' dimensions run support axis to support axis ('L' runs face to face)
conventions.rationale: The typical names its spans by their own dimension lines; Ln is axis to axis.

conventions.title: Continuous beam bottom bars beyond the far face of an interior support
conventions.source: ST7757 DXF CB typical details on SH03, SH05 and SH07: dimension text '7.5cm' at the bottom bar ends past the interior support
conventions.rationale: Printed on all three typicals; the end anchorage at an end support is not printed (BEAM_BAR_ANCHORAGE_D applies).

conventions.title: Project default slab thickness (unless a panel prints its own)
conventions.source: ST7757 PDF p.8 general notes (vector glyphs, Arabic): a note naming slab / roof thickness with the value 16 cm, read by local Arabic OCR (unreviewed); the frozen S1 census records the same default as P8-N18 + P1-NOTE-A
conventions.rationale: Panels without their own thickness tag take the project default; the two 2F panels tagged 'T 18' keep 18 cm. To be confirmed by a person (RFI).

conventions.title: Blinding projection beyond the footing / ground beam, each side
conventions.source: ST7757 PDF p.13 (vector drawing, read visually; not reviewed): the second typical footing detail dimensions the plain concrete 10 beyond the footing face; every typical ground-beam section dimensions it 10 | 30 | 10 under the 30 cm beam
conventions.rationale: Printed on the typical details; to be confirmed by a person with the blinding thickness (RFI).

conventions.title: Lintel schedule by opening width (cm)
conventions.source: ST7757 PDF p.13 'LINTEL SCHEDULE' (vector drawing, read visually, not reviewed): opening width 0-100 / 101-200 / 201-300 / 301-500 / 501-750 cm; size B x 20 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 55 (B = block wall width); bottom 2Ø12 / 2Ø14 / 3Ø16 / 3Ø18 / 4Ø18; top 2Ø10 / 2Ø12 / 3Ø14 / 3Ø14 / 3Ø14; stirrups 5Ø8/M
conventions.rationale: Bounds inclusive as printed; a width between two bands (e.g. 100.5 cm) is a schedule gap, never rounded into a band.
